dispute_ticket.description: The driver took a longer route and I was overcharged. I only asked for a quick 7-Eleven stop on the way, not a drive out to Beach Road.
dispute_ticket.driver_statement: Orchard was jammed after an accident, rider agreed to go round by Cavenagh and asked for a stop. I stopped at the 7-Eleven I know on Beach Road.

chat_logs.message: Hi, traffic on Orchard is bad, ok if I go round by Cavenagh?
Sure. Can you stop at a 7-Eleven on the way?

traffic_conditions.description: (20/9)13:52 Accident on Orchard Road (towards Bras Basah) after Cavenagh Road, two lanes closed.
